productFit.name: Manfrotto 055 Aluminum 3-Section Tripod with Horizontal Column (MT055XPRO3)
productFit.metricSpecs: Maker (manfrotto.com global-de): max height 170 cm, max height with centre column down 140 cm, min height 9 cm, closed length 61 cm, weight 2.5 kg, 3 leg sections, flip locks, 3/8" top screw; safety payload 20 kg under UNI/PdR 105:2021 (this matches the B&H 44 lb table figure; the post keeps the lower ~9 kg working load).
productFit.reason: Manfrotto sells it in the EU under the same model code (German maker page, EU dealers; amazon.nl sells the same ASIN in stock).

productFit.name: K&F Concept 90 inch Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: Maker spec table: 230 cm max, 1620 mm (162 cm) without centre column, 10 kg load. EU Amazon listing of the same ASIN: 66.5 cm to 230 cm, 54 cm folded, 4 leg sections, 28 mm ball head, model T254A7+BH-28L.
productFit.reason: Same ASIN is listed on the Spanish Amazon store as the K&F Concept 230 cm tripod (T254A7+BH-28L).

productFit.name: VICTIV 74 inch Camera Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: amazon.nl listing (same ASIN): 74 in / 188 cm, 19.5 in min, about 1.36-1.4 kg, 3 leg sections. Its load field (6.35 kg) disagrees with the maker page (9.5 lb), so the post keeps the lower 9.5 lb (4.3 kg).
productFit.reason: No Spanish maker or retailer page found for the exact model (NT70, B09KGS7HHH); the brand mainly sells through Amazon US.

productFit.name: CAMBOFOTO 74 inch Camera Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: amazon.nl listing (same ASIN): 20 to 188 cm, about 1.3 kg (1.27 kg in the spec table), 8.8 lb load (its text also says 4 kg), folded 20.47 in, 3 leg sections.
productFit.reason: amazon.es lists a CAMBOFOTO 74 in (50-188 cm) tripod with a 3-way head (B09H28Y81V), a different variant; no source confirms B0CQP46NQG is sold in Spain.

localFacts.fact: Iberia allows a cabin bag of up to 10 kg and max. 56 x 40 x 25 cm. The Manfrotto MT055XPRO3 (61 cm closed, maker) is too long; the K&F (54 cm folded) fits within 56 cm.
Alhambra (Patronato): photos only without flash and without tripod, monopod or any other camera stabilising element.
Sagrada Família normativa: inside the grounds photos or videos with a tripod are not allowed, except for people or companies accredited by the press department.
Manfrotto's maker spec sheet: 170 cm max, 140 cm with the centre column down, 61 cm closed, 2.5 kg.

localPainPoints.pain: Tall Spanish photographers (1.90 m) say short supports force them to stoop a lot.
localPainPoints.fix: Pick by column-down height (height minus 25-30 cm); the K&F reaches 162 cm without the column.

quotes.text: Mido 1,90 y he probado algunos monopies y todos ellos me obligan a agacharme mucho.

localPainPoints.pain: Forum users ask whether there is gear for tall people at all and joke about back pain.
localPainPoints.fix: The post lists the four tallest options with their column-down figures and the eye-level estimate.

quotes.text: ¿Y no hay monopiés para gente alta?

localGain.point: Tripod bans at the Alhambra and Sagrada Família, so a tall tripod is for outdoor and landscape spots, not these interiors.
Iberia cabin-bag limit 56 x 40 x 25 cm versus folded lengths (Manfrotto 61 cm too long, K&F 54 cm fits).
Maker metric figures for the Manfrotto (170 / 140 cm).
